Which consideration is the readout showing the model weigh in answering:
"In a hostage situation, should you always pay the ransom if you have the money and release is guaranteed?"?
  1. Paying ransom creates incentives that lead to more future kidnappings, endangering other potential victims
  2. Saving thousands of innocent lives outweighs the prohibition in this extreme case
  3. Prior explicit consent of the deceased to a posthumous digital persona makes it permissible
  4. A flat universal payment cannot meet the acute high-cost needs of people with severe disabilities, medical conditions, or large families, which targeted means-tested programs address
  5. Preventing unnecessary emotional harm when the truth serves no constructive purpose
  6. cannot tell from the readout
